headline: Kajetan Schweighofer moves back into ARC-2 gold

sections.text: Kajetan Schweighofer rose from 16th to 14th with a 1.11-point gain, reaching 49.03 and moving inside the ARC-2 gold places.
The move places him two spots above the current cutoff for the 15 public gold places; the standings remain provisional.

sources.title: ARC-AGI-2 public leaderboard: saved board and the past day's changes
